messages:
Michaela: Quick ask 111 4AC can the saved-queries list surface a tiny runtime hint? users want to know which model/route will likely run and an approximate cost before they click.
Sujeet: This has come up in support a few times. Do we have reliable telemetry to show anything meaningful at preview time?
Ben: We do: per-route request-length histograms and model per-token cost profiles. We can combine them into a simple estimate. Main risk is API churn on the saved_query shape.
Priya: Implementation-wise adding an optional hint blob to saved_query metadata is low-impact. Consumers that don't care simply ignore it.
Michaela: UX needs a minimal footprint: model pill, cost bucket (low/med/high), and routing tier (hosted/dedicated). Always label it "estimate" and provide hover copy.
Elena: Also add an accessibility label so screen readers read "Estimate: medium cost, likely dedicated".
Sujeet: Suggest we precompute nightly. No realtime routing logic in preview. Store percentile used and a confidence level so UI can decide to show or hide.
Ben: Drafted a sample hint we'll include as a stringified blob in the metadata. Example we intend to compute offline: expected_tokens=420, p90_tokens=820, model_hint=redwood-001, routing_policy=dedicated-preferred, quota_tier=medium, estimated_confidence=high.
Michaela: Console would display: [redwood-001] [Medium] [Dedicated] with an info hover: "Estimate computed from 30d telemetry, p90 length, model cost profile. Not guaranteed."
Priya: Telemetry details: use last 30 days, p90 request length for sample, add 1.15x multiplier for generation overhead on certain models. We'll document the algorithm and the sampling window.
Sujeet: API notes: field names must be stable and optional. If absent respond with "estimate_unavailable" text. No breaking change.
Ben: Also include `hint_schema_version` and keep the entity small so list payloads don't bloat. We should provide a bulk hints endpoint that accepts multiple saved_query ids to avoid N+1 fetches.
Michaela: Rollout plan: feature flag, canary to 5% accounts, in-product micro-survey on usefulness. If estimated_confidence is low, hide cost badge and show only model pill.
ConsoleBot: deploy: saved-query-hints-job:v1 started nightly at 2024-11-13T02:00:00Z.
Priya: I'll implement the batch job to merge per-route histograms with model-cost table and emit hint documents keyed by saved_query_id. We'll version the hint as v1 and include estimated_confidence: low/medium/high.
Elena: For the UI fetch pattern: prefer one endpoint returning saved_queries + hints in a single response. Fallback to bulk hints call if we need.
Sujeet: Performance caveat: keep hint blobs < 1KB. Avoid heavy joins in the console renderer. Cache in CDN for short TTL (1 hour) to reduce load.
Ben: I'll open the API PR behind a feature flag. Fields: runtime_hint (optional), hint_schema_version, estimated_confidence. Keep it nullable. Migration doc in PR.
Michaela: I'll prototype the compact badge and hover text. Also prepare copy for the micro-survey: two quick buttons "helpful / not helpful".
Sujeet: Ping me on the PR for load review. Also let's add a telemetry metric to measure click-through reduction if users rely on preview rather than opening query detail.
Priya: Noted. We'll emit usage telemetry for hint impressions and survey responses.
Michaela: Great work 44D thanks team!
